svg.aria-label: A grid of 64 bytes in 4 rows of 16, read without root from the configuration space of an integrated GPU presented as a PCIe function. Coloured fields: bytes 0 to 3, de 10 00 2b, vendor 0x10de and device 0x2b00; bytes 4 and 5, 06 04, command 0x0406 with memory space and bus master enabled; bytes 9 to 11, 00 02 03, class 3D controller; bytes 16 to 23, 0c 00 00 c0 d0 00 00 00, BAR0 = 0xd0c000000c, address 0xd0c0000000; byte 52, 40, the capability pointer; byte 61, 01, interrupt pin A.
svg.text: A configuration header, byte by byte
The first 64 bytes of a PCIe-function GPU, 0000:01:00.0.
command 0x0406: memory on, bus master on
interrupt pin 1 (INTA), switched off: MSI in use
Numbers wider than 1 byte are stored low byte first: de 10 is 0x10de.
